variants.specifics: Brackenford: Brother Anselm begs the player to bring his novice Pip back out of the Urchins' barrow.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Please, help me! My novice Pip went into the old barrow after those Urchins, and he has not come back!

The boy has the brains of a goose, may the heavens forgive me for saying so. Bring him home safe, my son. Go quickly!

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: Pip is still down there! Please, hurry!

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: Who's there? Oh, thank goodness! Did Brother Anselm send you? Get me out of here, please!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: Hurry! I think they're coming back!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
Pip! You're safe! Heavens be praised!

You have done a noble deed this day, kind sir. Take this ankh, with the blessing of the Chapel of the Ford.

journal.text: Rescue Pip, Brother Anselm's novice, from the old barrow.

variants.specifics: Kroth: Wilna begs the player to find her husband Jory, who went down the Flooded Shaft and has not come back.

plea.speaker: Wilna
plea.text:
Help me, please! My Jory went down the Flooded Shaft this morning and he hasn't come back! The other men heard screaming and ran!

Please, brave Adventurer, find him and bring him home!

reminder.speaker: Wilna
reminder.text: Please hurry! He's all I have!

found.speaker: Jory
found.text: Is somebody there? Help! I'm stuck back here!... Thank goodness! Did Wilna send you? Get me out of here!

following.speaker: Jory
following.text: Hurry! I can hear them coming!

completion.speaker: Wilna
completion.text: Jory! You're home! Oh, thank you, thank you! Please, take this Ankh as a token of my appreciation.

journal.text: Find Jory in the Flooded Shaft and bring him home to Wilna.

variants.specifics: Gloam: Hessa's boy Wim took a boat to the Sunken Graves to see the Undead and has not come back.

plea.speaker: Hessa
plea.text:
Oh, please help me! My boy Wim took the boat out to the Sunken Graves to see the Undead for himself. That was last night, and he hasn't come back!

Please, kind sir, find him and bring him home!

reminder.speaker: Hessa
reminder.text: Please, hurry! I can't bear to think of him out there alone...

found.speaker: Wim
found.text: Over here! Help! Please get me out of here!

following.speaker: Wim
following.text: Go on, I'm right behind you! Just get me home!

completion.speaker: Hessa
completion.text:
Wim! Oh, my boy! You're safe!

Thank you, thank you, brave Adventurer! It isn't much, but please take this. May all that is great bless you!

journal.text: Find Hessa's son Wim in the Sunken Graves and bring him home.

variants.specifics: Durnhelm: Merriwen's husband Jory, a soldier of the night patrol, is trapped by Skeletons in the Old Chapel on the moor.

plea.speaker: Merriwen
plea.text:
Please, help me! My Jory went out with the night patrol and never came back!

The others say the Skeletons drove him into the Old Chapel out on the moor. Nobody will go after him!

Please, kind sir, bring my Jory home!

reminder.speaker: Merriwen
reminder.text: Please hurry! I can't bear the waiting!

found.speaker: Jory
found.text:
Over here! Help!

Merriwen sent you? Bless her! I'll follow you.

following.speaker: Jory
following.text: Hurry! More of them are crawling up out of the floor!

completion.speaker: Merriwen
completion.text: Jory! You're home! Oh, thank you, thank you, brave Adventurer! It isn't much, but please take this.

journal.text: Rescue Jory from the Old Chapel and bring him home to Merriwen.

variants.specifics: Ostra: Agna's boy Wim rowed out to the Drowned Chapel on the north shore to see the ghosts and is trapped there.

plea.speaker: Agna
plea.text:
Please, help me! My boy Wim took his little boat out to the Drowned Chapel on the north shore to look at the ghosts. That was yesterday morning, and he never came back!

Oh, that foolish, foolish boy! Please, bring him home to me!

found.speaker: Wim
found.text: Help! Over here! Please don't leave me, they'll come back!

following.speaker: Wim
following.text: Stay close! I don't want to see any more ghosts!

completion.speaker: Agna
completion.text:
Wim! Oh, my Wim! You're home!

Thank you, kind sir, thank you! You've saved my boy. Please take this. I wish it were more.

journal.text: Rescue Agna's son Wim from the Drowned Chapel.

variants.specifics: Ardoth: Master Fenwold begs the player to bring back his apprentice Orrick from the catacombs under the old chapel.

plea.speaker: Fenwold
plea.text:
Oh, this is terrible! Terrible! My apprentice Orrick went down into the catacombs under the old chapel, east of town. He wanted to see a real Skeleton up close, the young fool!

He has not come back. Please, kind sir, bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Fenwold
reminder.text: Please, hurry! The poor boy must be terrified!

found.speaker: Orrick
found.text: Help! I'm in here! Master Fenwold sent you? Please, get me out of this place!

following.speaker: Orrick
following.text: Lead the way. I'll stay right behind you!

completion.speaker: Fenwold
completion.text:
Orrick! You're safe! Oh, thank goodness!

I am in your debt, brave Adventurer. Please, take this robe. It served me well when I was young.

journal.text: Rescue Orrick from the catacombs beneath the old chapel.

variants.specifics: Fort Skarn: Hulda begs for her husband Ansgar the woodcutter, chased into the old mine on the south slope by the Undead.

plea.speaker: Hulda
plea.text:
Help! Please, somebody help me! My Ansgar went out for firewood this morning and never came back!

One of the soldiers saw him run into the old mine on the south slope with the Undead right behind him. Please, bring him home to me, kind stranger!

reminder.speaker: Hulda
reminder.text: Please hurry! It will be dark soon, and so cold!

found.speaker: Ansgar
found.text: Over here! I'm stuck behind these rocks! Did Hulda send you?

following.speaker: Ansgar
following.text: Hurry, before those things come back!

completion.speaker: Hulda
completion.text: Ansgar! Oh, you're alive! Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Please, take this as a token of my thanks. May all good spirits watch over you!

journal.text: Rescue Ansgar the woodcutter from the old mine.

variants.specifics: Vulmar: Marga's boy Wim was dragged off by the Ogres to work the bellows of the Old Foundry.

plea.speaker: Marga
plea.text:
Please, help me! The Ogres came down in the night and dragged off my boy Wim! They took him up to the Old Foundry to work their bellows!

He's only a lad. I haven't much, but it's yours if you bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Marga
reminder.text: Why are you standing here? My Wim is up there with those brutes!

found.speaker: Wim
found.text: You came for me! Get me out of here, before they come back!

following.speaker: Wim
following.text: Hurry! Don't let them catch us again!

completion.speaker: Marga
completion.text: Wim! My Wim! Oh, thank you, thank you, kind stranger! Here, it isn't much, but take it with my blessing.

journal.text: Rescue Wim from the Ogres in the Old Foundry.

variants.specifics: Kesrin: Nell, cook at the Broken Wheel, begs the player to bring back her husband Gorm the carter, caught by Skeletons in the crypt under the old chapel west of town.

plea.speaker: Nell
plea.text:
Please, help me! My Gorm took the cart out to the old chapel west of here for stone, and the Skeletons came up out of the crypt and dragged him down! He never came home!

Please, kind sir, bring him back to me!

reminder.speaker: Nell
reminder.text: Hurry, please! He's been down there so long!

found.speaker: Gorm
found.text: Over here! Help! Get me out before they come back!

following.speaker: Gorm
following.text: Hurry, lad! I can hear them rattling!

completion.speaker: Nell
completion.text:
Gorm! You great oaf, you're alive!

Thank you, thank you, kind sir! Here, take this, it's all we can spare. And there's always a hot bowl for you at the Broken Wheel!

journal.text: Rescue Gorm the carter from the crypt beneath the old chapel.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Farmer Gedge begs the player to bring back his son Wil, dragged off by Ogres to their caves past the east fields.

plea.speaker: Gedge
plea.text:
Help! Somebody help me! The Ogres took my boy Wil! They grabbed him right out of the barley field and dragged him off to their caves past the east fields.

I'm too old to fight, and nobody else will go. Please, kind stranger, bring him home to me!

reminder.speaker: Gedge
reminder.text: Please hurry! Who knows what those brutes are doing to him!

found.speaker: Wil
found.text: Thank goodness! Did my Pa send you? Get me out of here before they come back!

following.speaker: Wil
following.text: Hurry! I think I hear them coming!

completion.speaker: Gedge
completion.text: Wil! My boy! You're safe! Oh, thank you, thank you, kind stranger! I haven't much, but take this, with my blessing.

journal.text: Rescue Farmer Gedge's son Wil from the Ogre caves.
